observed.short_response: Проверил первый пункт. Второй тоже в порядке. Ошибок нет.

code_review.correctness: typed contracts, expiry, confidence, rejection, persistence and context-shape paths covered
code_review.architecture: additive packages; backward-compatible optional integrations; no frontend or model changes
code_review.security: canonical secret filter plus sensitive/direct-identifier filtering; bounded local storage/retrieval
code_review.performance: 300-record cap, top-4 retrieval and bounded prompt; no network or unbounded history

known_limitations: Explicit preference extraction currently recognizes a bounded Russian/English phrase set.
Cross-process writes are not coordinated; atomic replace and locks cover one runtime process.
Contextual greeting requires a high-confidence unfinished Sprint 11 episode from the last seven days.
Hard sentence bounding is limited to non-streaming plain conversation so streamed text is never rewritten after display.
HumorPolicy calibrates the permitted level; the local conversation model still authors any actual humor.
